# UAV simulation results (PX4 SITL)

> **Status:** 6 runs on PX4 v1.16.2; unsafe outcome in SU-01; 3 findings recorded against the hazards. Synthetic simulation output, **no evidence credit**.

## Purpose

The committed results of the PX4 SITL failsafe runs: one JSON per scenario with the trace, the mode changes, the outcome and the measures it was decided on, and a summary with the findings. Pages, scenes and sheets read these files; nothing re-runs PX4 in CI.

## Boundary diagram

![Figure 4 · Boundary diagram](assets/sim/results/uav/figures/fig-4-boundary-diagram.svg)

| # | From | To | Crossing / interaction |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | PX4 SITL | SITL harness | HIL_STATE_QUATERNION ground truth, modes, status text |
| 2 | Scenarios and spec | SITL harness | sim/uav/scenarios.yaml, spec.yaml |
| 3 | SITL harness | Run files | SU-*.json (score(), trace) |
| 4 | SITL harness | Summary | summary.md with the findings |
| 5 | Run files | Readers | UAV scenes, sim pages, 3D scenes, sheets |
| 6 | Summary | Hazard records | findings recorded as causal factors and mitigations |

**Explicitly excluded:** verification evidence (these are synthetic runs), the harness and scenarios (in `sim/uav`), and a re-run in CI (PX4 is not built in CI; the committed files are what every page reads).

## SysML model

[`SitlResults.sysml`](https://github.com/jherrodthomas/Project-Susanoo/blob/main/sim/results/uav/SitlResults.sysml) is generated from the harness's `score()` and validated with the project model by the OMG pilot in CI.

![Figure 5 · SysML activity — ClassifyOutcome](assets/sim/results/uav/figures/fig-5-sysml-activity.svg)

| Order | Outcome | Decided when |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | keepout-breach | below the keep-out altitude, closer to the pilot than pilot_keepout_m |
| 2 | landed-at-stale-home | landed (PX4 disarmed), and landing point more than 5.0 m from the dock and the walker moved |
| 3 | geofence-overshoot | farthest point beyond geofence_radius_m + 2.0 m |
| 4 | landed-clear | landed (PX4 disarmed) |
| 5 | contained | the injection is reposition_beyond_fence_at_s |
| 6 | airborne-at-horizon | otherwise |

|---|---|

## Re-running

1. Follow [`sim/uav`](UAV-SITL-Harness) to run `python -m sim.uav.harness --px4 <checkout>` against the pinned PX4 version; `--compare` reports what changed.
2. Rebuild the pages that read the results, regenerate this page and run the full check list in [`CLAUDE.md`](https://github.com/jherrodthomas/Project-Susanoo/blob/main/CLAUDE.md).
